svg.title: GateKeeper
svg.desc: GateKeeper — Reactive zero-trust API gateway on Spring Cloud Gateway and Netty. Verifies JWTs against JWKS with a pinned issuer, authenticates API keys, and strips forged identity headers. 70 tests · WireMock + Redis.
